description: Author, render, preview and debug OpenForms FormSchemaJSON form definitions as idiomatic, themed, accessible MUI (React). Use when the user wants to design an OpenForms form, render an OpenForms schema with Material UI, convert an OpenForms JSON schema into a React MUI form, preview a form schema, or debug conditional-logic / calculated fields / cross-field validation in an OpenForms schema. This is the OpenForms *form-builder* schema (github.com/henriquefps/open-forms) — NOT the "open-form.dev" documents-as-code framework, which this skill does not cover.
